title: How Much of the Statutory Tax Posted Enters a Hotel Rate Plans Departure Balance
content:
Whether the statutory tax standing on a Hotel Rate Plans folio is charged in the balance settled at departure turns on whether such lines are there at all and on where the reservation record stands.

## The rule

1. Where the folio carries statutory tax lines and the reservation stands at checked in or checked out, 100 percent of the statutory tax posted is charged.
2. Where the folio carries statutory tax lines and the reservation stands at cancelled or recorded as a no show, 0 percent of it is charged.
3. Where the folio carries no statutory tax line, 0 percent of it is charged.

## The combinations

| Statutory tax lines on the folio | Reservation record stands at | Share of the statutory tax posted charged |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | checked in | 100 percent |
| yes | checked out | 100 percent |
| yes | cancelled | 0 percent |
| yes | recorded as a no show | 0 percent |
| no | any standing | 0 percent |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

Statutory tax of 200.00 USD standing on the folio:

- With the reservation at checked in, 100 percent is charged, being 200.00 USD; the same figure follows at checked out.
- With the reservation at cancelled or recorded as a no show, 0 percent is charged, being 0.00 USD.
- Where no statutory tax line stood on the folio, 0 percent of nothing would be charged whatever the standing.
